comment: Read by scripts/third-party-notices.mjs. 'copyright': crates for which no licence file with a real copyright notice exists in the crate or its repository. Their text is the licence template of cargo-about with the placeholder replaced by 'holder'. basis 'authors': holder is the authors field of the crate (checked against cargo metadata at the exact version). basis 'repository': holder named from the upstream repository, see 'source'. An entry is used only for the exact name and version, and an entry that is no longer needed is an error. 'vendored': web files that the program serves to the browser but that come in with the vole-kit crate (a git dependency, static/ in https://github.com/Ferdinand99/Vigilant-Vole at the tag of vole-kit); the licence texts are committed in legal/, and 'lockPackage' pins the vole-kit version in Cargo.lock that they were checked against, so a new version of the kit fails the check until its files and licences are looked at again. 'fontLicenseFile': the licence of the Inter font that the kit serves.
intro: The Rust crates are those that the server binary is built from (the static Linux builds
for x86_64 and aarch64 that the Docker image contains). A crate that only runs while the
program is built (a build script) is not listed. A crate that is only used at build time
through a procedural macro may be listed.
The web interface also serves a few third-party files to the browser, which come with the
vole-kit crate: htmx and the Inter font. They are listed after the Rust crates.
